Through close coordination with programme, MEAL, Protection, and Complaints and Feedback Mechanism teams, the position strengthens accountability, promotes participation, supports safeguarding and protection principles, and contributes to evidence-based decision-making and the effective, dignified delivery of food assistance in line with organizational and donor standards. Key Responsibilities: Beneficiary Identification and Management: Conduct category-wise beneficiary identification for the General Food Assistance Programme in accordance with approved GFA eligibility criteria and World Food Programme (WFP) active beneficiary lists. Utilize, verify, and validate WFP-shared active beneficiary data to ensure accuracy, eligibility, and alignment with programme requirements. Lead and support beneficiary inclusion exercises to identify newly eligible households following approved criteria, standard operating procedures, and coordination mechanisms. Lead and support beneficiary exclusion exercises, including verification of ineligible, duplicate, or no-longer-eligible households, in close coordination with relevant technical teams. Ensure all inclusion and exclusion decisions are evidence-based, transparent, and compliant with approved programme criteria. Maintain comprehensive documentation, approvals, and justification records for all beneficiary inclusion and exclusion decisions. Inclusion and Exclusion Exercise: Plan, coordinate, and oversee beneficiary inclusion and exclusion activities at the field level to ensure timely and effective implementation. Facilitate community-based verification and validation processes to identify newly eligible households and confirm beneficiary status. Coordinate assessments and verification processes for ineligible, duplicate, or disputed cases in collaboration with Programme, MEAL, Protection, and CFM teams. Ensure exclusion processes adhere to due process, accountability, and protection principles, minimizing risks to affected populations. Document inclusion and exclusion outcomes and ensure timely updating of beneficiary records and databases. Coordination and Communication on Beneficiary Identification Management: Support beneficiary inclusion and exclusion activities in close coordination with Programme, MEAL, Protection, and Complaints and Feedback Mechanism (CFM) teams. Ensure beneficiaries are appropriately informed about inclusion and exclusion processes, criteria, and outcomes through approved communication channels and community engagement approaches. Database and Information Management: Maintain, update, and regularly enhance beneficiary databases to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and integrity. Support data cleaning, verification, reconciliation, and alignment with WFP systems and internal organizational records. Ensure confidentiality, safe handling, and protection of beneficiary data in accordance with data protection and information security standards. Beneficiary Referral and Follow-up: Identify beneficiaries requiring referrals to relevant services and assistance mechanisms in line with programme objectives. Coordinate referrals with concerned internal teams and external partners as appropriate. Conduct systematic follow-up on referrals to track outcomes and document results for reporting and accountability purposes. Emergency Preparedness and Response: Prepare, maintain, and regularly update beneficiary master lists and disaggregated datasets for emergency response purposes. Ensure availability, accuracy, and timely updating of beneficiary databases to support rapid response during emergencies. Coordinate with Programme and relevant teams to support emergency beneficiary verification, targeting, and response planning. Safeguarding, Protection, and Compliance: Ensure full compliance with WVB safeguarding policies to protect beneficiaries and staff from harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation. Promote and uphold safeguarding principles, including Gender Mainstreaming, Protection, Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), and Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP). Follow and encourage adherence to safeguarding reporting and referral procedures for any reportable incidents. Ensure the safety, dignity, and well-being of beneficiaries throughout all programme activities. Comply with organizational policies, including child protection, health and safety, equal opportunities, and the code of conduct. Coordination and Reporting: Work closely with Programme, MEAL, Protection, and CFM teams to ensure integrated and coordinated implementation of GFA-related activities. Participate in coordination meetings, field-level reviews, and programme planning sessions as required. Prepare and submit regular activity reports, updates, and documentation to the supervisor in a timely and accurate manner. Ad-hoc Activities: As per requirement in changing context, support to sectors in performing relevant activities.

job_description: Who We Are A R Malik Seeds Pvt. Ltd. is one of Bangladesh's pioneering private seed companies, founded in 1969 by Mr. A. R. Malik. For over five decades, we have supplied high-quality hybrid vegetable and potato seeds to farmers across every district of the country, working to make agriculture more productive, climate-resilient, and profitable for the people who depend on it. Through our own Research & Development farm in Birganj, Dinajpur, and long-standing partnerships with globally renowned breeders such as Sakata Seed Corporation (Japan), BASF-Nunhems (Germany), and Agrico (Netherlands), we bring internationally proven seed technology to local farmers. As our operations, research, and farmer-outreach programs continue to grow, so does our need for a reliable, well-run IT backbone. Your Role in Our Mission As our IT Executive, you will be the hands-on custodian of the technology that keeps A R Malik Seeds running — from the network and servers to the laptops, CCTV, and email systems used every day by our teams in the office and in the field. You will be equally comfortable configuring a firewall, restoring a backup, or walking a colleague through a printer issue. The way you maintain, secure, and troubleshoot our systems will directly shape how smoothly our research, marketing, and administrative teams operate — and, in turn, how well we can keep serving farmers across Bangladesh. How You'll Make an Impact Network & Security Configure and troubleshoot MikroTik routers and switches, including VLANs, routing, NAT, firewall rules, VPN, DHCP, DNS, and Wi-Fi. Monitor network performance and resolve connectivity issues across office and field locations. Server & Infrastructure Management Administer Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, file/application services, and system monitoring. Manage virtual machines, storage, and RAID on VMware ESXi or Proxmox, along with underlying server hardware. Microsoft 365 & Email Administration Administer Microsoft 365 users and licenses, and support Outlook/email issues. Maintain basic email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) to keep company email deliverable and secure. Backup & Disaster Recovery Monitor backup jobs, perform data restores, and troubleshoot backup failures. Support basic disaster-recovery procedures to minimize downtime and data loss. End-User & Hardware Support Provide hands-on support for PCs, laptops, printers, CCTV/NVR, IP devices, and other office IT equipment. Maintain IT asset records and ensure equipment is properly deployed and accounted for. IT Security, Documentation & Vendors Maintain patching, access control, and up-to-date IT documentation. Coordinate with ISPs and hardware/software vendors to resolve issues and manage service requests. What You Bring Strong practical knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLAN, routing, NAT, DNS, DHCP, and VPN. Hands-on experience with MikroTik RouterOS, including firewall configuration and network troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server / Active Directory. Basic administration experience with VMware ESXi or Proxmox. Microsoft 365 administration and email troubleshooting experience. Solid hardware, operating system, and network troubleshooting skills. Preferred CCNA / MTCNA / MTCRE certification or equivalent practical experience. Exposure to Cisco/BDCOM equipment, Docker, Apache/Nginx, MariaDB/MySQL/PostgreSQL, Zimbra/Roundcube, or backup systems is an advantage.
